title: SMS provider adapter behind a send port
name: SMS provider adapter

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how the adapter classifies provider responses and protects against duplicate sends? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
The provider responds 503 with header Retry-After: 3600. When does the worker schedule the next attempt?
choices: In 15 minutes, because the delay is capped
In 1 hour, as the header requests
Never; the message is marked failed

questions.prompt: The provider's callback later reports a new status string "scheduled" that this adapter doesn't know. What does mapStatus return, and why does that matter?
choices: "queued", which keeps the message non-terminal so later updates can still move it forward
"sent", which assumes the provider accepted it
It throws, so the callback handler returns an error

questions.prompt: The provider rejects the request with HTTP 401 because the auth token was rotated. What happens to the message?
choices: Retried immediately in a tight loop
Rescheduled 15 minutes out with reason 'provider auth rejected'
Accepted with an empty provider message id
